description: Source code for a user turn stop strategy class that uses turn detection models to determine when a user has finished speaking, integrating with audio frames, VAD, transcription, and turn analysis.

classes.name: TurnAnalyzerUserTurnStopStrategy
classes.description: Implements a user turn stop strategy using turn detection models, handling audio, VAD, transcription frames, and managing turn completion events.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the turn analyzer user turn stop strategy with turn analyzer, timeout, and other parameters.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the strategy to its initial state, clearing internal variables and events.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up the strategy with a task manager, creating an asynchronous task for monitoring events.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up resources, including turn analyzer and cancelling the monitoring task.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames (audio, transcription, VAD, start, speech control) to update turn analysis and strategy state.

methods.name: _start
methods.description: Handles start frame to configure turn analyzer sample rate and broadcast turn parameters.

methods.name: _handle_speech_control_params
methods.description: Synchronizes VAD start delay with turn analyzer parameters.

methods.name: _handle_input_audio
methods.description: Handles raw audio frames, updating turn state and possibly marking turn as complete.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_started_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD event indicating user started speaking.

methods.name: _handle_vad_user_stopped_speaking
methods.description: Handles VAD event indicating user stopped speaking, analyzes end of turn, and resets transcription timeout.

methods.name: _handle_transcription
methods.description: Handles transcription frames, updating text and resetting timeout.

methods.name: _handle_interim_transcription
methods.description: Handles interim transcription frames, resetting timeout.

methods.name: _handle_prediction_result
methods.description: Processes turn analysis prediction results, pushing metrics frames.

methods.name: _task_handler
methods.description: Asynchronous loop monitoring events and triggering user turn stop when conditions are met.

methods.name: _maybe_trigger_user_turn_stopped
methods.description: Triggers user turn stopped event if turn is complete and transcription exists.
